title: On Knocking twice at the garden door
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：knock　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 knock 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the director ① knocked twice at the garden door in silence, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② knocks twice at the garden door twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ knock twice at the garden door at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ knocked twice at the garden door before — a line in the poster for August 1964 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Knocking twice at the garden door in silence, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ knock the ash from his pipe twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Knock the ash from his pipe at once and never mention it again.

By 1977 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ knocks the ash from his pipe in silence every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ knocked twice at the garden door again when nobody else would.

⑩ To knock twice at the garden door, my mother said in 1982, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody knocks twice at the garden door twice over again and somebody must knock twice at the garden door in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 敲（一般过去式 knocked twice at the garden door：1970 年导演头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 敲（一般现在 knocks twice at the garden door：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 敲（不定式 to knock twice at the garden door：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 敲（过去完成时 had knocked twice at the garden door：1964 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 敲（动名词 knocking twice at the garden door 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 敲掉（knock the ash from his pipe：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去敲掉把烟斗里的灰敲掉）
G. v. 敲掉（knock the ash from his pipe：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 敲（后段两处：新来的演员照例 knocks the ash from his pipe，而母亲又一次 knocked twice at the garden door）

knock 意为“敲”，自那以后导演来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 knocks。
knock 意为“敲”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯敲在园门上敲了两下”，此处为不定式 to knock twice at the garden door。
knock 意为“敲”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1977 年之前就有人敲过，故用过去完成时 had knocked。
knock 意为“敲”，导演说“敲在园门上敲了两下这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 knocking twice at the garden door 作主语。
knock 意为“敲掉”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去敲掉把烟斗里的灰敲掉”，should ever 之后用原形 knock the ash from his pipe。
knock 意为“敲掉”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻敲掉把烟斗里的灰敲掉（knock the ash from his pipe at once），以后再也不要提起。
knock 意为“敲”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例敲掉把烟斗里的灰敲掉，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 knocks。
knock 意为“敲”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地敲在园门上敲了两下，用一般过去式 knocked 叙述。
knock 意为“敲”，结尾那句是母亲 1982 年的话：要敲在园门上敲了两下，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 knock 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the director knocked twice at the garden door in silence, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director knocks twice at the garden door twice over whenever the theatre asks.
Knocking twice at the garden door in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever knock the ash from his pipe twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre knocks the ash from his pipe in silence every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother knocked twice at the garden door again, and the theatre remembered that half.
